parity.title: Absolute Scarcity Parity
parity.description: What would 1 XNO be worth if all assets were valued purely by their scarcity?
parity.tableDescription: Value based on total supply ratio: 1 unit of Asset A = (Total Supply of B) / (Total Supply of A)
parity.keyTakeawayText: This table accurately reflects the scarcity hierarchy. Each XNO represents a much larger share of its fixed network than a single Dollar or Euro represents of their infinite and expanding networks.
parity.blockquote: Based purely on absolute, un-inflatable supply, a single unit of Nano is fundamentally scarcer than a single unit of any other asset on this list—including Bitcoin and Gold. This is the power of a fully distributed and absolutely fixed supply.

about.title: About NanoMarketCap
about.intro: is a cryptocurrency market cap tracker that puts Nano (XNO) at the center of everything.
about.perspective: Unlike traditional trackers that use fiat as a base currency, we flip the perspective: all prices, market caps, and dominance metrics are calculated relative to XNO.
about.feature2: 24h price changes relative to XNO performance
